contributions.detail: THE DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION (§A6), and it must be read loudly: the 5 Schedule A rows sum to 50 + 100 + 200 + 50 + 2209.96 = 2,609.96 exactly = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = Box C, the CUMULATIVE cell. The promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B prints 2209.96 — which is precisely the single 4/20/2024 row (Keven Ewell, 2209.96), the only entry dated after the 4/19/2024 original report this filing amends. So the filer restated the WHOLE CYCLE on the schedule while booking only the new period figure in Box B. Nothing was differenced across covers and no figure was synthesised: the sum is tested against the printed figure matching ITS OWN SCOPE, which here is the cumulative one. Schedule A's second footer, 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report)', is left WHOLLY BLANK by the filer, so the page subtotal and Box C are the only contribution anchors. The summary ladder closes on its own terms: F = A + B = -2209.96 + 2209.96 = 0, close = F - D = 0 - 0 = 0, exactly as printed. Consequence downstream (§A6): the rows and their sum publish, and reconciles_contrib is left BLANK = UNKNOWN rather than True, because 2,609.96 and the module's promoted per-period figure are different SCOPES.

expenditures.detail: TRACED, NOT ASSERTED, and nothing was nudged. The 14 printed Schedule B rows sum to 2,729.23, which is +119.27 over the filer's printed subtotal of 2,609.96. The attribution is UNIQUE from the page alone: rows 1 THROUGH 13 sum to 100 + 250 + 712.25 + 18.87 + 191.98 + 308.13 + 150 + 27.94 + 295.49 + 70 + 326.65 + 133.78 + 24.87 = 2,609.96 EXACTLY, i.e. to the cent equal to the printed subtotal, and the excess is exactly the printed amount of the LAST row (row 14, 4/13/2024 Printology 'Brocures' 119.27). This is the §D5 spreadsheet SUM-RANGE SLIP class — the omitted row is the last of a contiguous typed range, which makes the attribution unique by contiguity even though 119.27 alone would not be. Screens run before calling it filer arithmetic: (a) §H3 DOUBLED BAND — ruled out; every measured band on p3 is one pitch (~4.13) and the shortfall here is an OVERSHOOT, not the shortfall a missed row produces; (b) §F1 trap 5, a row below the last printed rule — ruled out by a crop of the strip immediately below the grid (pct:74.0,78.03,13.3,4.5@p3), which rendered the printed 'page $ 2609.9…' subtotal label and no entry; (c) §H4, a subtotal written inside the grid — ruled out, row 14 is 119.27 and the rows above it already total 2,609.96, so 119.27 is an entry, not a total; (d) CORRELATED-ERROR screen — 'not-correlated-by-absence': index.csv holds exactly ONE Ewell filing (this one), and the 4/19/2024 original this amends was never published, so there is no sibling ledger to compare. Row 14 is published VERBATIM at 119.27 with needs_review=1, and the filer's printed subtotal is retained verbatim at 2,609.96. Note the scope point separately: even without the row-14 slip this side would NOT have been per-period — the schedule restates the whole cycle from 12/26/2023 and matches Box E, while Box D prints 0.
